decision: The top-level src/echo-home boundary is removed. Configured state_dir is the sole authority for current product state, compatibility code receives concrete paths from callers, and durable atomic file replacement lives in vendor-neutral filesystem infrastructure.
implemented_capabilities: path-policy-free atomic file replacement under src/infrastructure/filesystem
explicit checkpoint, health, and legacy configuration path inputs for remaining compatibility workers
product source boundary rejects any reintroduction of src/echo-home
architectural_invariants: src/product/paths.ts derives all current product-state locations from configured state_dir
generic filesystem infrastructure receives destinations and sensitivity policy from callers
canonical core and adapters do not read ECHO_HOME or depend on mutable process-global path state
historical extraction provenance remains immutable after relocation
